svg.title: Stationary source-sink flux on a fixed landscape
svg.desc: Conceptual three-panel illustration. A broad Gaussian perturbation supplies a source, one fixed score field transports flux, and a fine Gaussian perturbation supplies a sink. The finite noise-grid identity explicitly retains the residual R_N. Colored path marks occur at different times and do not assert a common-time optimizer distribution. Turning marked paths into stopped generator outputs requires geometric retention.
